headline: Millions still needed for Alabama Farm Center in Warrior
snippet: After passage, millions still needed to develop Farm Center on 500-acre property.

headline: Agriculture center bill passes Alabama Legislature amid controversy, filibuster threats
snippet: Passed amid filibuster threats over ALFA's outsized role in board appointments and tax-exempt status.

headline: Senate bill draws fire over involvement of Alabama Farmers Federation
snippet: Criticism over ALFA receiving more board appointments than the governor.

headline: Senator threatens to stall session over Farm Center bill
snippet: Sen. Shelnutt threatened to stall session if SB219 did not pass.
